svg.title: THE SKILLSET BULLETS
svg.desc: Twenty-four rounds, one per chamber. Case length shows the size of that chamber's live working brief in action items. A round with no brief is a blank and the router will not fire it. Full figures are given as a table in the page text.
svg.text: One round per chamber. The charge is the live brief — 241 action items across 24 rounds.
A round with no live brief is a BLANK. The router refuses to fire it — an empty chamber is a safety feature, not a gap.
